a generalized model for droplet motion in microfluidic networks is developed and used to design a multi input multi output control system to achieve on demand control of droplets.
we have proposed a generalized approach of modeling and controlling droplets, and demonstrated the ability to dynamically generate and manipulate droplets in a microfluidic network.
we have developed an active control system for droplets in microfluidic networks.

a novel approach of using electropneumatic valves to manipulate droplets in a microfluidic network.
the development of a general framework for droplet manipulation and control.
the development of a computer vision based multi input multi output control system for on demand manipulation of microfluidic droplets.

the proposed model and control system can be used to manipulate individual droplets in a droplet microfluidics platform in a more robust, efficient, and user friendly manner.
the proposed model is a generalized model of droplet motion in a microfluidic network.
we have demonstrated a novel approach for active control of droplet microfluidics based on computer vision feedback.

we have developed a robust control framework for the on demand manipulation of microfluidic droplets based on computer vision feedback.
a robust and reliable system for on demand manipulation of individual microdroplets is developed.
a multi input multi output control system has been developed for on demand manipulation of individual droplets.

a droplet microfluidics network can be controlled as a whole, and the control system can be used to generate, trap, sort, and move droplets according to user demand.
